news.headline: A $500M redemption is planned as FTAI Aviation (FTAI)'s subsidiary prices new debt.
Debt that funded a share buyback is targeted for repayment as FTAI Aviation (FTAI) plans a notes offering.
FTAI Aviation Subsidiary Launches $1 Billion Senior Notes Offering Due 2034
FTAI Aviation Unit Launches $1 Billion 2034 Senior Notes Offering
FTAI Aviation launches $1B senior notes offering due 2034
news.summary: Subsidiary FTAI Aviation Investors LLC launched a private offering of $1.0bn senior unsecured notes due 2034 to repay the revolver drawn for the accelerated share repurchase and redeem part of the 5.50% notes due 2028. Fitch assigned the new notes a BB- rating and affirmed existing debt.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation (NASDAQ:FTAI) Shares Climb 7.6% - Still a Buy?
news.summary: FTAI rebounded roughly 7-8% on November 2 with unusually high options volume, recovering the post-earnings pullback as the debt refinancing plan was announced.

news.headline: Quarterly profit reached $151M at FTAI Aviation (FTAI), but nine-month operating cash use grew.
news.summary: FTAI's Q3 10-Q shows net income of about $151M, while operating cash usage over the first nine months increased as the company builds engine and module inventory.

news.headline: A Look at FTAI Aviation Ltd (FTAI) After 4.5% Decline -- GF Value $256.04 vs Price $187.27
news.summary: FTAI gave back part of its post-earnings rally, falling about 4.5% to roughly $187 on October 30 as some coverage questioned valuation after the Q3 miss on EPS and revenue.

news.headline: FTAI Maintained by RBC Capital -- Price Target Raised to $265
news.summary: RBC Capital kept its rating on FTAI and lifted its price target to $265 following the Q3 report, one of several post-earnings target moves as analysts digested the buyback and reaffirmed guidance.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation Ltd. Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Performance and Announces $500.0 Million Accelerated Share Repurchase
news.summary: Q3 revenue rose 46.6% y/y to $977.7M and adjusted EBITDA hit a record $348.3M (+17%), led by Aerospace Products (+76%); 2026/2027 EBITDA guidance was reaffirmed. The board doubled the buyback authorization to $1.0bn, with $500M executed immediately via an ASR, and shares jumped ~14% despite a slight EPS/revenue miss.

catalysts.label: $1B 2034 notes pricing and $500M ASR execution
catalysts.detail: Pricing/closing of the $1.0bn senior notes (rated BB- by Fitch) will refinance the revolver used for the ASR and part of the 2028 notes; ASR settlement determines the share-count reduction.

catalysts.label: Investor meeting in New York
catalysts.detail: Scheduled investor meeting; a likely venue for 2027 guidance and an update on the asset-light SPV strategy and FTAI Power.

catalysts.label: Q4/FY2026 results
catalysts.detail: Full-year report should show whether FTAI landed within its reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance and give the first quarterly read on the ASR's share-count impact.

catalysts.label: FTAI Power Mod-1 first deliveries
catalysts.detail: CEO Joe Adams said the Mod-1 cleared its critical testing milestones ahead of first deliveries next year, against the $1.465bn hyperscaler order.

pulse: As of November 2, 2026, FTAI is building on its October 29 Q3 report (record adjusted EBITDA of $348.3M, revenue +46.6%, reaffirmed 2026/2027 guidance) and a $500M accelerated buyback within a doubled $1.0bn authorization. On November 2 it launched a $1.0bn 2034 senior notes offering (Fitch BB-) to refinance the ASR-funding revolver and part of its 2028 notes, and shares rebounded about 7-8% after a valuation-driven pullback to ~$187. Next up are notes pricing and ASR execution, the December 10 investor meeting and first FTAI Power Mod-1 deliveries in 2027.
